title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 084
review_goal: Differentiate share, shoe, and shopping bag variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Three round nodes linked by two diagonal connector lines in a branching network
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants share to feel like connected points spreading through a small network.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the arrow leaving a square when the share action should read like sending outward from a box.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot builds share from linked nodes instead of an arrow exiting a square frame.

items.depicts_observation: Open square frame with one arrow launching upward from the upper right corner
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants share to feel like pushing content out of a container or window.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the connected node share when the mark should not resemble a branching network diagram.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot centers on a square and outward arrow instead of three linked share nodes.

items.depicts_observation: Low sneaker profile with a pointed toe and lace bumps and a flat sole trailing behind
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a casual sneaker silhouette instead of formal or heeled footwear.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the high heel pump when the shoe should not rise on a thin back heel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reads as a lace up sneaker rather than a dress shoe with a lifted heel.

items.depicts_observation: High heel silhouette with a curved top opening and pointed toe and thin raised heel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants elegant heeled footwear instead of a low casual sneaker silhouette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the sneaker when the shoe should not show laces or a long flat sole.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the distinct lifted heel and pointed pump shape instead of a sneaker body.

items.depicts_observation: Simple upright shopping bag with a flat base and straight sides and one rounded carry handle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the plainest bag silhouette with no flap or decorative inner opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bag variants with a smile like inner cutout or a folded top flap across the opening.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the clean straight sided shopping bag without extra top detail beyond the handle.
